authorization.text: Ok, dann gebe forge doch eine kleine Aufgabe zum Test

purpose: Prove one bounded Forge implementation handback through the hardened relay.

task.instruction: Implement public_failure_summary(evidence). Return a new dict containing only kind, detail, returncode, elapsed_seconds, timeout_seconds, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes, stdout_sha256, stderr_sha256, and signals when those keys exist. Ignore every other key. Copy signals into a new list so callers cannot mutate the input through the result. Raise TypeError when evidence is not a dict. Keep the function under 20 nonblank lines.
acceptance: Only the ten allowlisted keys can be returned.
signals is copied when it is a list.
Include exactly three plain assert examples.
Return only one Python fenced code block and no prose.
